gpu_visibility: Parent worker sets ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES and unsets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Runner asserts device_count=1 and uses cuda:0 without setting visibility.
orchestration_disposition: Finish CPU validity checks and retain first-screen artifact. Parent explicitly deferred GPU dispatch in favor of complementary priority lanes.
primary_metric: validation clean-context full-vocabulary exact next-token accuracy AUC on newly introduced B/C tasks at matched optimizer updates
proof_limitations: Small synthetic classification task; not open-ended agent ability or long-horizon continual-learning evidence.
Capacity refresh adds a new frozen-history rank-8 adapter per stage; trainable rank is matched but cumulative inference rank increases.
Replay replaces one new-task example per batch; total updates and examples are matched, new-task exposure is lower and logged.
Policy editions are visible inputs; revision measures scoped versioned rule learning, not erasure of obsolete global knowledge.
A single screen seed is exploratory and cannot establish reproducibility.
GPU training and checkpoint reload have not yet run.
selection_rule: Only nominate after A acquisition and fresh-reference learnability gates; candidate mean B/C AUC gain >=0.03 with <=0.05 retention regression. Confirm on untouched test splits and another training seed before claiming a repeatable gain.
torch_policy: Keep the image's existing ROCm torch distribution and constrain using importlib.metadata.version; do not install requirements in an environment that resolves torch replacement.
